description: Fetch live Polymarket prediction markets with implied outcome odds, 24h volume, liquidity, and orderbook bid/ask spreads. Filter with optional keyword `q`, `min_volume_usd` (default 0), `limit` (1-50, default 15), and `include_closed` (default false). Returns `markets[]` with `question`, `outcomes`, `volume_24h_usd`, and `spread_bps`. Do not use for DeFi yield pools (use get_defi_yield_pools) or crypto news (use get_crypto_news). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

include_ai.description: Optional dual-GPU (3060+3080) brief on top mispriced/active markets

q.description: Optional keyword filter (e.g. bitcoin, fed, trump, eth)

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

name: get_polymarket_markets
title: Polymarket live odds & spread radar
